about_the_game:
Step into typical Spanish sun-baked places, and prepare for Fast and Fractured experience, a frenetic physics-based driving shooter for up to 8 contenders— in a chaotic multiplayer battle royale. Choose from 4 colorful characters, each sporting 2 unlockable skins, and battle it out across different maps inspired by stereotypical Spanish places like an old-school Spanish town, while having fun with cheeky elder-villager humor.

Key Features

Four Distinct Drivers: Pick one of four quirky locals—each with two unique skins—and master their handling quirks.

Frenetic Physics Combat: Push, dash, and blast opponents into the dust, leveraging realistic weight, grip, and push-shot mechanics.

Two Game Modes: Jump into Single-Player Showdowns with up to 12 AI contenders, or host your own multiplayer lobby and battle friends in custom chaos.

Beloved Locales: Battle across iconic spots like:

Mountain Village – A vibrant Spanish-inspired village where narrow streets, sun-baked tiles, and a bustling market set the scene—until a giant chicken shows up to ruin everyone’s day.

Golf Volcano Island – A once-serene golf course based around an inactive volcano now turned chaotic battleground—complete with perfectly trimmed bushes and way too many statues of its “glorious” owner, Josefino.

Construction Site– A dusty construction site buzzing with machinery, chaos, and a front-row audience of local grandpas who’ve made “watching the works” their favorite sport. They’re not working, but they sure have opinions on how everyone else should.

Vibrant, Stereotypical Charm: Overflowing with Spanish jokes, elder-villager antics, and brightly colored, cartoon-inspired art.

Quick Matches, Big Laughs: Perfect for streamers and content creators seeking dynamic, shareable moments.

CHARACTERS

Josefino: Charming and wealthy, Josefino has extravagant tastes, has tons of money to throw around and enjoys golfing.

Maria Antonia: A loving and caring grandmother, Maria Antonia takes care of her grandchildren by cooking them tons of food, especially croquettes.

Pepe: A retired farmer, Pepe loves taking strolls around his crops. He goes everywhere with his tractor and reminisces of his past self.

Carme: Crazy for her chickens, Carme still tends to her farm and always has remedies for every sickness with herbs.
